sentences.span: TACTICALLY BULLISH – We moved to a Cautious / Neutral stance on Aug 31... Jay Barry sees the 10Y yield... ending the year at 5.05%.
sentences.why: JPMorgan (source field confirms JPMorgan) went from Cautious/Neutral (set Aug 31) to Tactically Bullish on the view yields find a level and oil trends lower; Jay Barry's forecast is 5.05% year-end, matching exactly.

sentences.span: CCC spreads have widened 11 of the last 14 days, approaching '22 levels... IG Tech CDS at their widest since '23.
sentences.why: BTIG (source field confirmed) frames credit stress as the reason a correlation-one selloff is coming ('we see one sooner than later'); CCC widening 11/14 sessions toward 2022 levels and IG Tech CDS (=investment-grade tech default-insurance cost) at 2023 wides both match exactly.

sentences.span: their ~$1.22 trillion of Phase 2 capex requires ~$1.00 trillion of 2028-30 revenue - equal to ~59% of the current backlog, and assuming zero further backlog growth
sentences.why: The source states required revenue ($1.00tn) is 59% OF the $1.69tn backlog — i.e. the backlog already exceeds the requirement even with zero new bookings. The sentence inverts this into the backlog 'covering 59% of the requirement,' implying a shortfall where the source shows the opposite (backlog is ~169% of what's needed).
